hyperedges.label: Dark Mode Persistence and Anti-Flash Flow

nodes.label: State-Based Navigation (currentView)
nodes.rationale: No router by design; navigation is driven by currentView state in App.jsx, keeping the SPA simple and role guards centralized.

nodes.label: Two-Level Role Guard Convention (RLS + App.jsx)
nodes.rationale: Role-based access is enforced at two levels: Supabase RLS is authoritative; App.jsx render conditions are the UI layer. New views require a currentView value, a role guard in App.jsx, and a nav entry in Navbar.jsx.

nodes.label: Realtime Channel Cleanup Pattern
nodes.rationale: Supabase Realtime channels must be removed on unmount (return () => supabase.removeChannel(channel)) to avoid leaked subscriptions; TaskList.jsx and KanbanBoard.jsx establish the pattern.

nodes.label: Transient Supabase Client for Admin signUp
nodes.rationale: UserManagement.jsx uses a second Supabase client with persistSession: false so signUp does not overwrite the Admin's active session; the pattern must not be changed.
nodes.norm_label: transient supabase client for admin signup

nodes.label: Photo Evidence Gate on Hecho Drop
nodes.norm_label: photo evidence gate on hecho drop

nodes.label: No 'fetch' Function Name Rule
nodes.rationale: Never name a function fetch inside a component because it shadows the browser global; use fetchItems, fetchTasks, etc.

nodes.label: Three-Level Role Guards (RLS + DB Trigger + Client)
nodes.rationale: Defense in depth: Supabase RLS is the authoritative boundary, trg_restrict_asignado_update enforces column-level restrictions, and client guards in App.jsx/KanbanBoard.jsx only prevent rendering unauthorized UI.
nodes.norm_label: three-level role guards (rls + db trigger + client)

nodes.label: trg_restrict_asignado_update Trigger
nodes.rationale: Enforces at DB level that Asignado can only modify estado and evidencia_url; when adding new updatable columns for Asignado the trigger's exclusion list must be updated.

nodes.label: Asignado Update Own Task RLS Policy
nodes.rationale: The policy needs both USING and WITH CHECK clauses; removing WITH CHECK would allow an Asignado to self-reassign tasks.
nodes.norm_label: asignado update own task rls policy

nodes.label: evidencias Storage Bucket
nodes.rationale: The bucket is public because getPublicUrl requires it; access is still constrained by explicit INSERT/SELECT/DELETE RLS policies, and the public URL is stored in tareas.evidencia_url.

nodes.label: Dark Mode Strategy (Tailwind class + localStorage)
nodes.rationale: Tailwind darkMode:'class' toggled on <html> by App.jsx; preference read lazily from localStorage falling back to prefers-color-scheme; DOM sync lives in a useEffect (not the state setter) as the correct React pattern.

nodes.label: Anti-Flash Dark Mode Script
nodes.rationale: An inline script in index.html applies the dark class before React hydrates, preventing a white flash on page load.

nodes.label: Kanban Board (Drag-and-Drop, All Roles)
nodes.rationale: Applies optimistic state updates on drag-end for responsiveness, with Realtime confirming the persisted state afterward; the Realtime channel name is unique per component instance (kanban-tareas-${useId()}) to prevent duplicate subscriptions on rapid unmount/remount; Admin/Gestor cards use a drag handle so buttons stay clickable, while Asignado cards are fully draggable.

nodes.label: Forward-Only Status Transitions for Asignado
nodes.rationale: Asignado may only drag Pendiente to En curso to Hecho; dragging backward from Hecho is blocked in handleDragEnd, so reopening requires Admin/Gestor.

nodes.label: Photo Evidence Gate (PhotoModal before Hecho)
nodes.rationale: If foto_requerida = true and the user is Asignado, dropping on Hecho opens a PhotoModal before persisting; Admin/Gestor bypass the gate.

nodes.label: Transient Supabase Client for User Creation
nodes.rationale: UserManagement.jsx creates users with a transient client (persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false) so signUp does not overwrite the Admin's session in localStorage; the profile row created by on_auth_user_created is then updated with the selected role.
nodes.norm_label: transient supabase client for user creation

nodes.label: Auth Init via onAuthStateChange Only
nodes.rationale: Auth initialization uses onAuthStateChange exclusively (no getSession) because INITIAL_SESSION fires synchronously, avoiding a concurrent double-fetch race on the profile.

nodes.label: State-Based View Routing (No React Router)
nodes.rationale: State-based navigation via currentView in App.jsx is intentional; each view maps to a component with role restrictions (tasks/form/reports/users/catalogs).

nodes.label: TaskList.jsx Kept for Reference (Deprecated)
nodes.rationale: TaskList.jsx is no longer in the main navigation flow because all roles now use KanbanBoard; it is retained for reference and can be removed in a cleanup.

nodes.label: Roles Feature (Administrador/Gestor/Asignado)
nodes.rationale: New users default to the Asignado role until an Administrador changes it from the Users view.

nodes.label: Security Model (RLS, WITH CHECK, Column Trigger)
nodes.rationale: Permissions are enforced at the database (RLS) rather than only the client; WITH CHECK prevents self-reassignment; trg_restrict_asignado_update column-locks Asignado; client guards are an additional defense layer.
nodes.norm_label: security model (rls, with check, column trigger)

nodes.label: Supabase SQL Setup Order
nodes.rationale: The four SQL files must run in order: schema.sql, then add_fecha_limite.sql, storage_evidencias_policies.sql, security_rls_and_stability.sql; afterward the first admin is granted via a manual UPDATE on usuarios.
